title: Steen Thomsen (Copenhagen Business School corporate-governance professor) — 'A book whose time has come.'
summary: Steen Thomsen — Professor of Corporate Governance at Copenhagen Business School and a long-time scholar of foundation-owned and steward-owned company structures — sends Eric a reader review of Incorruptible calling out exactly the design problem the book argues for and stamping it 'a book whose time has come.'
blockquote: This is an outstanding book that points the way forward to corporate America and to the start up community in particular. It provides tested means for companies to remain true to purpose and avoid the corruption of it that would otherwise ensue. The book is well written, highly informative and transformative. A book whose time has come.
blockquote_source: Steen Thomsen, via Eric Ries on LinkedIn
attribution_title: Professor of Corporate Governance, Copenhagen Business School
